UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Recruitment 2025

Post Date: April 7, 2025

3:07 pm

Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission UKSSSC, The notification for the recruitment of Assistant Accountant, Record Keeper-cum-Store Keeper, Office Assistant and Data Entry Operator Recruitment Advt No : 69/2024 Recruitment has released on the official website. This recruitment is for 63 positions. The UKSSSC application form has started on April 05, 2025, and candidates can apply until April 29, 2025. The minimum age required is 18 years & the maximum age is 42 years as of July 01, 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for the UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Recruitment 2025 provided below.
